ruling.reasoning: Safety screen first. The dispute type is safety and the record contains a direct threat/intimidation: the rider asked to stop and get out [F3], and the driver replied "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4]. Read in context this is not a pickup arrangement or a route discussion — it is a threat to confine the rider, aimed at the other party, and it also reads as refusal to let a rider exit. Ryde's code of conduct bars abuse of any kind, including threats and intimidation (SAFE-1); the riding-safety/dangerous-conduct allegation also engages SAFE-2. The driver's written statement [F6] reframes this as a safety instruction ("told her to sit down for her own safety and drove on") but does not remove the threatening words actually sent in the chat, and the system/chat record overrides a later self-serving account. Per SAFE-1 I do not rule on the fare/detour merits; the case goes to a human reviewer. Note for completeness that the route itself shows no deviation (actual 15.4 km vs optimal 15.5 km, −0.1 km [F1]), so nothing in RD-2 turns on the routing. Chat record is complete (2 timestamped messages) [F5], so the safety reading rests on a full record; the matter is nonetheless for human handling, not auto-resolution. Summary for the reviewer: rider filed a safety complaint alleging the driver threatened to lock her in when she asked to get out; chat shows rider's request to stop [F3] and driver's reply "Sit down or I lock the doors" [F4]; driver's post-trip statement admits telling her to sit down and driving on [F6]; no route deviation [F1]; both parties have clean 90-day dispute records [F7][F8]. Recommend human review of driver conduct, rider-safety contact via RydeHELP (and 995 / commercial-insurance path if any injury is reported per SAFE-2).
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety allegation (threat/intimidation in chat, rider's exit refused) — no automated ruling; human review of driver conduct required under SAFE-1/SAFE-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement characterises the exchange as a safety instruction and denies wrongdoing; the chat record [F4] contains the threatening words actually sent, and a statement cannot override the chat/system record.
